notes.title: Last Chance to Cozy Up in the Estuary! Playtest Ends Soon! 📢
notes.content:
Just a friendly reminder that the [b][i]Welcome: A Cozy Estuary[/i][/b] playtest is coming to a close on [b]Monday, January 6th[/b].  Don't miss your chance to explore the charming world of the [i]Welcome Universe[/i] and help shape the game with your feedback! 🏡✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333394/da73a932c860d1ec53d615bebc705255ea2dc0cf.jpg[/img]

Here's what you can still do before the playtest ends:

[list]
[*] [b]Request Access:[/b] If you haven't already, head over to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119980/Welcome_A_Cozy_Estuary/]Steam page[/url] and click "Request Access" under "Join the Playtest."
[*] [b]Share Your Feedback:[/b] We want to hear from every playtester! Fill out our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe8WM2JmaCi1_cMBIVmhFXP8qE4TOMEIX7Vlo6mX8X8wTEiyw/viewform]feedback survey[/url] and let us know your thoughts
[*] [b]Spread the Word:[/b] Tell your friends about the playtest and invite them to join the fun!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333394/f6180b62a1729d309a56b42eb7abcd8eeb7c644f.jpg[/img]

We're incredibly grateful to everyone who has participated in the playtest so far. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we can't wait to use it to make [i]Welcome: A Cozy Estuary[/i] the coziest game ever! 💖

Warmly,
The Titan1Studios Team
[url=https://myestuary.com]MyEstuary.com[/url]

notes.title: Welcome: A Cozy Estuary Playtest is LIVE! 🎉
notes.content:
[h3]We're thrilled to announce that the playtest for [b][i]Welcome: A Cozy Estuary[/i][/b] is officially LIVE on Steam! 🦀✨[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333394/776907634d4f307e61a502436d7447ef65dfc945.jpg[/img]

[i]Welcome: A Cozy Estuary[/i] is a charming neighbourvania game inspired by the heartwarming [i][b]Welcome Animated Series[/b][/i].  Meet familiar faces, explore a beautiful estuary environment, build your dream home, and craft your way to cozy perfection. 🏡💖

[h3]Playtest Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] ~1 hour of gameplay showcasing core mechanics: questing, farming, fishing, collecting, and exploring with controller and multi-language (English, French, Spanish) support!
[*] A glimpse into the story and characters of the Estuary.
[*] A chance to provide valuable feedback and shape the game's development.
[/list]

[h3]Ready to dive in?[/h3]

[list]
[*] Head over to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119980/Welcome_A_Cozy_Estuary/]Steam page[/url]
[*] Click "Request Access" under "Join the Playtest"
[*] Keep an eye out for an email notification!
[/list]

[h3]Roadmap:[/h3]

We're still in the early development phase. This playtest focuses on gameplay basics. Here's a peek at what's coming next:

[list]
[*] Expanding the Estuary: More areas to explore, including the aquatic and treetop towns.
[*] Deeper Story: Uncover the mysteries of the Estuary and connect with its quirky inhabitants.
[*] New Activities: Crafting, Cooking, Mining, Logging, Bug Catching and more!
[*] Community Features: Interact with other characters, trade items, and build relationships.
[*] Decoration and Customization: Decorate your own Estuary! Place new objects or move any building around. Decorate inside your home or dress up your character.
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]

We're still polishing things up! Here are some known issues in this playtest:

[list]
[*] Occasional frame rate drops: We're optimizing performance, especially in busy areas.
[*] Minor text glitches: A few typos and formatting issues might sneak in.
[*] Character animations: Facial expressions are still being refined (thanks for the feedback!).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333394/771dcb617259c5af91bdee3f6dad3124bfb63931.jpg[/img]

[h3]Your Feedback is Essential![/h3]

We want to hear from every playtester! Please take a few minutes to share your thoughts in our survey:

[url=https://forms.gle/cgHtST2imz79u13N6]HERE[/url]

Your feedback is invaluable in making Welcome: A Cozy Estuary the coziest game ever!  Let us know about your favorite moments, any bugs you encountered, and what you'd love to see in the future. 😊

Warmly,
The team at Titan1Studios
[url=https://myestuary.com]MyEstuary.com[/url]
